Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- **Decision recorded:** a doc-only app lands on its first shown `doc` entry, as a last resort after the declared landing and the first `object` / `page` / `dashboard` / `report` / `component` entry. A doc entry has an in-app route (`/apps/SEG/docs/BOOK[/DOC]`, via `buildItemRoute`), and #28450 already lands on a doc named by a declared landing. A mixed app with a doc first still lands on its first non-doc entry. Apps with only `url` / `action` entries, and apps whose entries live only under `areas`, keep today's `null`; the os-dev files that as a finding.
- **File surface widened by the designer's mirror:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppPreview.tsx` (`findFirstLanding`, which mirrors `findFirstRoute`) gets the same last resort, so the app designer's preview names the landing the runtime opens. Plus one case in `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`. Nothing else in either file changes.
